meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会先派子代理查文档和示例,再按阶段输出实施计划;每个阶段都附文档出处、验证清单和要避免的写法,最后做整体验证。
howto.when: 当你说要规划一个功能、任务或多步实现时触发,尤其在使用 do 执行之前。

say.text: 帮我分阶段规划这个新功能,先查文档再出计划。
say.note: Claude 会先做文档调研,再给出分阶段计划。

say.text: 为一个多步任务做实施计划,每阶段要附验证清单。
say.note: 计划会包含可执行的验证步骤。

say.text: 规划前先确认哪些 API 真实存在,不要凭空发明。
say.note: 子代理会先核对文档中的 API 和签名。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first dispatch subagents to read documentation and examples, then produce a phase-by-phase implementation plan; each phase cites doc sources, includes verification checklist and anti-pattern guards, with final verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Plan this new feature in phases — check the docs first.
say_en.note: Claude does doc discovery, then returns a phased plan.

say_en.text: Make an implementation plan for a multi-step task, with checks per phase.
say_en.note: Each phase will include how to verify it works.

say_en.text: Before planning, confirm which APIs really exist — don't invent any.
say_en.note: Subagents verify API names and signatures in docs.
